super mario bros. wonder nintendo switch.description: Save the Flower Kingdom in the latest side-scrolling Super Mario adventure—now with more content and improvements for the Nintendo Switch 2 system Turn classic Mario side-scrolling gameplay on its head with the addition of Wonder Flowers. These game-changing items trigger spectacular moments you have to see to believe. Witness singing and dancing piranha plants, turn into a Goomba,  and more in these unexpected events called Wonder effects. Set out on an adventure to save the Flower Kingdom from Bowser and take on Bowser Jr. and all seven Koopalings in boss battles through the various worlds. Choose from a cast of characters including Mario, Luigi, Peach, Daisy, and more—this Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition  also features Rosalina and Co-Star Luma. Grab surprising power-ups, like the trunk-trouncing Elephant Fruit and the flower-hopping Super Flower Pot, to help you along the way. You can also enable Assist Mode to become immune to damage, and recover from falls with the Propeller Flower, if you’re having trouble—regardless of which character you are playing as! Meet up with friends for attractions and entertainment in Bellabel Park. Captain Toad has discovered Bellabel Park in the Flower Kingdom! Explore this area with your friends in local*, online**, or local wireless* multiplayer in the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition. Visit the attractions to cooperate or compete using a variety of game mechanics. Share the wonder with friends and Mario fans near and far. Gather up to four people around one system* to experience the game-bending Wonder effects together as you tackle courses as a team and help each other on your way to the Goal Pole. Online**, you can work together or turn a course into a friendly race to finish first. Even when playing solo, connecting online lets you see live player shadows of up to 11 other Mario fans around the world as they embark on their own journeys. See how they approach each course and get their help when you’re in trouble. Find standees left by other players to help recover from falls—or place your own. You can also play the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition with friends who don’t have the game, in person or online, via GameShare***. Unlock and equip badges with various effects Want some more midair time? Equip the Parachute Cap. Want an extra boost underwater? Dolphin Kick is your best bet. Having trouble perfecting your platforming? Safety Bounce will save you from a fall. Using your badges together with power-ups is the key to saving the Flower Kingdom! * Additional games, systems and/or accessories may be required for multiplayer mode. La impresión dinámica de la colección evoca las fuerzas de agitación de la tierra y el agua. Estos elementos crudos e impredecibles invitan a los atletas a conectarse con sus instintos primarios más profundos a prevalecer en el Octagon. La UFC Fusion de Venum Fight Week Women’s Pullover Hoodie en Oceanic Blue presenta una marca blanca limpia en el pecho, el brazo izquierdo y la espalda del hombro derecho. El bolsillo frontal de estilo canguro y capucha de cordón añaden acabado a esta capucha premium. Pare con otras piezas de estilo de vida de la misma colección.
